texts:
您想在英国品尝又美味又地道的中国菜吗？看来您选对了，这家位于伦敦的中餐厅 “胡同”可以您让垂涎三尺，流连忘返！“胡同”在这异国演绎着别有特色的中国北方美味佳肴，从火辣担担面、到红似灯笼的软壳螃蟹，应有尽有。“胡同”得名于交纵在北京城中的胡同，并由在香港备受食客欢迎的同名餐厅发展而来。

一进餐厅，一股浓浓的中国风迎面扑来，高挂着的红灯笼，手工雕刻的镂空月形木门、茶砖砌成的茶墙、1940年代的复古茶罐，让您仿佛置身于华夏土地。

“胡同”位于The Shard大厦第33层，叹为观止的伦敦全景尽收眼底，如果您傍晚时分前来，品尝美食的同时还能欣赏白昼转黑夜的伦敦奇景。还在等什么，想体验空中进餐的您不容错过！

贴士一：明星出没请注意！

贴士二：浪漫约会的最佳圣地！

贴士三：不妨试试我们的推荐菜如双椒芽香辣龙虾肉、担担面、烤鸭！

Situated on level 33 of The Shard, Hutong serves the fascinating and diverse cuisines of Northern China. With panoramic views over the London skyline, Hutong is based on the much-loved restaurant of the same name in Hong Kong and is named after Beijing’s ancient hutongs – the now fast-disappearing narrow lanes which criss-crossed the city revealing its old family houses, their grand courtyards and life within. Traditional Chinese red lanterns and beautiful hand-carved wood-panelled ‘Moon Gates’ adorn the room, while a wall of tiled tea bricks (compressed dried Chinese tea) and vintage 1940s tea canisters celebrate the link between China and London and its old tea warehouses. Two semi private dining rooms also offer a stunning view for larger groups. Hutong has been placed in the top 100 restaurants at the National Restaurant Awards for two consecutive years and won a Three Tier Pagoda, (the highest accolade,) at the Legacy of Taste awards. Guest can enjoy Hutong’s dramatic interior with panoramic views over the London skyline and stunning Northern Chinese cuisine.
